gcm.purpose: Source-control and deploy MediaForge flexible naming recipes for request-specific batch naming jobs.
changeNotes: Adds MediaForge 2.2.0 flexible Naming Recipes with saved presets, per-job overrides, custom field order, case, separator, aliases, and sequence maps.
Adds batch preview with unresolved mapping warnings, manual filename overrides, CSV manifest export, and rename-only ZIP export that preserves image bytes.
Adds the Liberty Lincoln 25 Signature Interiors starter preset without silently guessing unresolved mappings.
Adds permanent MediaForge naming regression coverage and a dedicated Cloudflare Pages production deployment workflow.
